summary: Phase 2-5 comprehensive testing of Sogrape Balanced Scorecard. FIXED a critical compile blocker in StrategyMapView.jsx (stray duplicate JSX fragment after export default caused webpack SyntaxError, blocking the entire app). After fix: Backend 10/10 new pytest cases passed (strategy-edges add/self-loop-400/delete, initiatives CRUD with measure_ids, update-actuals shape returns updated+created+project, JSON import roundtrip creates new project, JSON import with minimal payload backfills defaults, AI SSE stream returns text/event-stream + terminates with [DONE] + 3000+ chars of Claude Sonnet 4.5 content). Frontend end-to-end verified via Playwright on seeded 'Sogrape Demo' project: 6 top-level section tabs (Scorecard/Dashboard/Strategy Map/Alignment/Initiatives/Reports), Dashboard renders 4 Recharts + StatCards + FilterBar with LIVE re-aggregation (overall 48.8% -> 14.3% when Perspective=Financial only -> back to 48.8% on Clear), Strategy Map renders 4 objective nodes and 'Suggest standard chain' bulk-creates 3 edges (L&G->Internal->Customer->Financial) that PERSIST across full page reload, Initiatives CRUD works (create with linked-measure checkbox -> card appears, delete -> card removed with toast), Reports downloads all succeed as real files (JSON 8.3KB, CSV 1.1KB, XLSX 26KB, PDF 380KB), AI Analyze dialog streams a well-formatted markdown executive briefing to ai-summary-content (3197 chars observed) with Regenerate button visible. Zero console errors, zero 4xx/5xx network calls during the whole flow.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration_1: PUT returns request payload minus id, not the full stored record. Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED IN THIS ITERATION — stray duplicate JSX fragment appended after the first `export default StrategyMapView;` produced a Babel SyntaxError ('Missing semicolon. (221:67)') and put the CRA compile-error overlay full-screen over the app, making the entire /scorecard, /portal, and every other route unreachable. Removed the trailing duplicate block so the file now ends cleanly at the first export.

action_items: Add a pre-commit / CI eslint check for the frontend so a mid-file stray JSX block like the one in StrategyMapView.jsx doesn't reach the preview environment again — a bare `npx eslint src --max-warnings 0` would have caught this before hot-reload.
(Nit, carry-over from iteration_1) PUT /api/projects/{pid}/objectives could return the fully-hydrated stored objective so the client doesn't need a follow-up GET after edits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /projects/{pid}/strategy-edges does NOT validate that source and target actually exist inside the project's objectives array — you can push edges pointing to arbitrary UUIDs and they'll persist. Consider looking up both ids in doc.objectives and returning 400 otherwise, symmetrical to the source==target check already in place.

server.py POST /projects/{pid}/strategy-edges also does not de-duplicate (source, target) pairs, so 'Suggest standard chain' can be clicked repeatedly and each click will silently add another edge on top of the existing three. Since the frontend batches ~3 POSTs on each click, a user double-clicking the button leaves 6 overlapping edges. Recommend a uniqueness check on (source,target) before push.

server.py POST /projects/import blindly accepts arbitrary JSON and stores it — a malicious payload could include extra top-level fields (e.g. '__proto__', large arrays) that get persisted verbatim. Consider whitelisting the known keys instead of setdefault+insert of the whole payload.

server.py ai_summary streams tokens as `data: {chunk}

` where {chunk} replaces 
 with the literal characters '
'. If the model ever emits a raw carriage-return, or the chunk itself starts with 'data:' or a colon, the SSE framing will break. Consider prefixing each line with 'data:' and joining, or base64-encoding the payload.
StrategyMapView.jsx trailing duplicate JSX (now fixed) shows there is no linter running on save — turning on eslint react/jsx-no-comment-textnodes and no-unreachable would help.

ReportsView.jsx invokes html2canvas on the entire #report-print-area synchronously in the click handler; on very large scorecards this can freeze the tab. Consider using html-to-image or splitting the render into pages.
AiSummaryDialog uses a raw fetch reader; if the streaming connection drops mid-way the UI stays in the 'streaming' state forever (no timeout/abort). Add an AbortController + timeout for robustness.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the initial full-app blocker: StrategyMapView.jsx had lines 220-229 as a duplicate/stray copy of the legend markup pasted after `export default StrategyMapView;` on line 219 — specifically the fragment began with `ssName="flex items-center gap-1.5">` (missing `cla` prefix, clearly the tail of a botched paste), causing Babel to raise 'Missing semicolon. (221:67)'. Repro: `curl -I https://.../portal` returns 200 but the DOM renders CRA's red 'Compiled with problems' overlay because webpack-dev-server injects the error at the top of every page. Fix: delete lines 220-229 so the file ends at line 219 (`export default StrategyMapView;`). Verified fix by tailing /var/log/supervisor/frontend.*.log and observing 'Compiled successfully!' plus by re-loading /portal and successfully navigating to /scorecard.
